subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Should the external Weixin package own and ship the new reload-marker contract before this Gateway change is accepted, and should live two-account provider proof be required for that release path?
rationale: The core seam is generic, but selecting the permanent contract owner and the evidence bar for an external provider package requires gateway and plugin-owner intent rather than another mechanical Gateway-only edit.

options.title: Ship the plugin contract and prove it live
options.body: Release and pin a Weixin package that declares the marker in its loaded ChannelPlugin, then provide redacted account-A-plus-account-B QR-login evidence on the exact head.

options.title: Merge catalog metadata into loaded registrations
options.body: Make the official catalog’s declared reload metadata augment loaded external channel registrations, with compatibility tests that establish the catalog as the authoritative contract.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the existing whole-channel behavior until a Weixin owner can sponsor the metadata contract and provider-level validation.

recommendation.title: Ship the plugin contract and prove it live
recommendation.body: Release and pin a Weixin package that declares the marker in its loaded ChannelPlugin, then provide redacted account-A-plus-account-B QR-login evidence on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged channel-reload work is the closest evidenced ownership trail for the shared restart-planning contract.
